title: Nvidia says its forecast for $200 billion CPU market includes China
title_zh: Nvidia表示，其预计2000亿美元的CPU市场包括中国
summary: TAIPEI, May 23 (Reuters) - Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on Saturday that his forecast of a $200 billion market for CPUs ‌includes China, signalling Nvidia still sees significant long-term demand in the market ‌amid ongoing U.
summary_zh: 路透台北 5 月 23 日 - Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋周六表示，他对 2000 亿美元 CPU 市场的预测包括中国，这表明 Nvidia 仍然认为，在美国持续不断的经济形势下，该市场仍存在巨大的长期需求。

title: SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic: Investors are 'better off' waiting for IPOs
title_zh: SpaceX、OpenAI、Anthropic：等待 IPO 的投资者“状况更好”
summary: Private markets are in focus, with initial public offerings (IPOs) from Anthropic (ANTH.PVT), OpenAI (OPAI.PVT), and SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) on the horizon.
summary_zh: 私募市场成为焦点，Anthropic (ANTH.PVT)、OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 和 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 的首次公开募股 (IPO) 即将到来。

title: Maybe investors can wait to buy SpaceX after IPO: Lee Munson
title_zh: Lee Munson：也许投资者可以等待 IPO 后购买 SpaceX
summary: Elon Musk's private space operator, SpaceX (SPAX.PVT), released its S-1 filing this week as it plans to go public via IPO in June. The Wall Street Journal has reported that AI developer OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) is preparing to file for its own mega-IPO.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的私人太空运营商 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 本周发布了 S-1 文件，计划于 6 月通过 IPO 上市。据《华尔街日报》报道，人工智能开发商 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 正准备申请大型 IPO。
